name: Confluent Agent Skills
summary: Official Apache-2.0 Agent Skills pack from Confluent for Kafka, Flink, Schema Registry, CDC and Confluent Cloud workflows.
description: confluentinc/agent-skills is the official GitHub pack of AI agent skills for stream processing and event streaming with Confluent. Official LICENSE is Apache License 2.0. The repository is not archived; created 2026-03-13 and last pushed 2026-11-11T21:14:44Z (2026-11-11 22:14:44 Europe/Stockholm). Official README lists these skills: flink-udf; kafka-schema-registry; kafka-streams-programming; developing-kafka-java-client; developing-kafka-python-client; confluent-cloud-cdc-tableflow; confluent-cloud-flink-sql; msk-migration; confluent-cloud-provider-integration; confluent-skill-reviewer; confluent-skill-creator; and confluent-tuning-advisor (advisory-only configuration diffs; the administrator applies the change). Official wording: skill performance may vary because underlying language models are continuously evolving and nondeterministic; all outputs and code modifications generated by these skills should be carefully reviewed and tested, especially for production applications. Official README Installation (re-fetched 2026-11-28): under Claude, `/plugin marketplace add confluentinc/agent-skills` then `/plugin install streaming-skills-plugin@confluent-agent-skills`; under the `skills` CLI (pick specific skills, most agents), `npx skills add confluentinc/agent-skills`. None of these installs were executed. Confluent Cloud or other paid Confluent usage is separate and was not purchased.

agent_access.notes: Public Apache-2.0 GitHub pack. No hosted MCP endpoint is documented on this repository. README installs: `/plugin marketplace add confluentinc/agent-skills` + `/plugin install streaming-skills-plugin@confluent-agent-skills` (Claude), or `npx skills add confluentinc/agent-skills`; none were executed. Confluent Cloud usage is separate and was not purchased.
